purpose: Personal Renoa Host identity artwork. Arcee and Soundwave depict Transformers Prime characters, not original Renoa characters.

assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one original premium 3D emblem for Renoa, a personal modular AI Host that connects independent agents. This is a finished small web UI avatar asset, not a mockup or a page. Subject: three beautifully sculpted interlocking gold arcs gathering around a small luminous central gold seed, forming a distinctive open asymmetric knot. Coherent bold silhouette, clear at 64 pixels, few broad surfaces, physical polished champagne gold with rich bronze shadows and narrow specular highlights. Almost straight-on view with subtle dimensional depth. Centered subject fills 78% of a square, with generous symmetric safe padding for a circular crop. Background solid very dark warm charcoal #24211c, no scene or floor. Original symbol; absolutely no letters, no r, no dot, no typography, no existing brand mark, no blue, no blue lighting, no circuitry clutter, no decorative outer frame. One asset only, square image.
assets.derivative: 384px WebP, quality 88; alpha preserved; no creative retouching.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a finished square avatar portrait of ARCEE, the actual character as designed in the 2010 Transformers Prime animated television series. Entire helmet tips and chin comfortably inside a central circular crop; strong silhouette that reads at 64px. Soft warm studio rim light, character's original blue and silver colors retained, flat very dark WARM charcoal #24211c background, no blue background, no environment. No text, letters, badges, logos, border, watermark, or additional characters. This is one personal-use app avatar asset, not UI mockup. Square image.
